journey.name: prepared fee review
journey.description: Verifies that an on-chain send from Savings whose prepared transaction costs more mining fee than the confirmation showed is not broadcast under that approval: the confirmation returns with the actual fee, and the payment goes out only after a second swipe, with PIN or biometrics when they are enabled for payments. Preconditions: an onboarded regtest wallet with a PIN required for payments, coin selection set to automatic First-In-First-Out (Settings, Advanced, Coin Selection), Savings funded with ./lsp deposits, and ./lsp available to deposit and mine while the Confirm screen stays open. Confirm normally preselects inputs and the send reuses them, so the fees agree. They diverge when the amount is within about one fee of the whole balance: preselection fails (the app log shows "Selecting UTXOs" with no "Selected" line), Confirm estimates without fixed inputs, and a coin confirmed while Confirm is open is added at send time (observed: 180 sats shown, 277 sats prepared). Find that amount by entering the Savings balance minus the fee of spending every output without change and lowering it by a few sats until the log shows the failed preselection. If the "Received Bitcoin" sheet covers Confirm after the deposit, close it with its button before swiping. The second swipe must follow within two minutes: after that the review closes with a toast saying the payment was not sent. On the emulator, drive the swipe with adb shell input draganddrop across the handle; a plain input swipe does not register. ./lsp has no transaction lookup: confirm a broadcast by mining a block and watching the sent activity confirm. A refusal logs "Asking to approve prepared fee"; after it there must be no second "sendOnChain" call and exactly one "Created sent onchain activity".

actions.action: Open Send, enter a second regtest wallet's address, and enter the near-balance amount found as the description says, then continue to the Confirm screen (tag "SendConfirmContent")
Expand Show Details (tag "SendConfirmToggleDetails") if collapsed and record the fee shown under Speed and Fee

With the Confirm screen still open, deposit a new output to this wallet's Savings address with ./lsp and mine one block, then wait until the Savings balance includes it; close the Received Bitcoin sheet if it opens over Confirm
Swipe the send handle (tag "GRAB") fully to the right and enter the PIN

Verify the Confirm screen (tag "SendConfirmContent") is shown again instead of the success screen, the fee under Speed and Fee is higher than the recorded one, the amount (tag "ReviewAmount") is unchanged and the send handle (tag "GRAB") is back at its start; take a screenshot right after the swipe to capture the Fees changed toast
Tap the Speed and Fee value, the amount (tag "ReviewAmount") and Add Tag (tag "TagsAddSend") and verify none opens another screen
Swipe the send handle (tag "GRAB") fully to the right again and enter the PIN
Wait for the Bitcoin Sent success screen (tag "SendSuccess"), tap Details (tag "Details"), and verify the sent activity shows the higher fee, not the first recorded one
Return to the wallet home screen, repeat the first five actions for another send that returns to the Confirm screen with a higher fee, then press system Back
Verify the send sheet closes without a success screen or an error toast, the activity list has no new sent payment, and a new send to the same address reaches the Confirm screen
